recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-26603 unless OO separately reopens the later Group-vs-inline-criteria design question or the already-audited FHIR-41671 changes.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 change request to replace ObservationDefinition.qualifiedInterval and standalone valid/normal/abnormal/critical coded value set elements with a common qualifiedValue(s) BackboneElement carrying the same context, appliesTo, gender, age, gestationalAge, and condition criteria for both ranges and coded value sets, also under component.
initial_application: The substantive source change was applied in February 2021 ObservationDefinition update commits 1872b9243b and 56b91f72c1. FHIR-26603-specific follow-up commits 389aef2302 and 9c23150c01 fixed definition punctuation and renamed qualifiedValues to the singular qualifiedValue. Current fhir.ini keeps migration aliases from old qualifiedInterval and top-level coded-value paths to ObservationDefinition.qualifiedValue children.
additional_context: The Jira-linked Zulip thread records why discrete/nominative value sets needed the same inline qualifiers as continuous and ordinal ranges. OO Confluence minutes list FHIR-26603 as the new qualifiedValues backbone and record acceptance of the related catalog block vote. Later Applied issue FHIR-41671 renamed qualifiedValue.gender to sexParameterForClinicalUse and added qualifiedValue examples; it already has a combined-branch audit commit, so the current SPCU name is not a seed issue mismatch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active ObservationDefinition differential defines ObservationDefinition.qualifiedValue with context, appliesTo, sexParameterForClinicalUse, age, gestationalAge, condition, rangeCategory, range, and valid/normal/abnormal/critical coded value set children, and ObservationDefinition.component.qualifiedValue content-references that same backbone. The CQL model content mirrors qualifiedValue at both root and component levels. Old qualifiedInterval and top-level coded-value paths were not found as active source definitions outside migration aliases and diagram/example/current child-name occurrences.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 ObservationDefinition issue renamed qualifiedValue.gender to qualifiedValue.sexParameterForClinicalUse and added qualifiedValue examples; it explains a current naming difference from the 2020 request and already has a combined-branch audit commit.
